detail: Full summary: the committed plugin bundle is ALREADY stale on foundation/v3 and this change does not make it newly so — plugin/server/twining-server.mjs is 1,385,871 bytes against a fresh 1,641,873 (last rebuilt at the 2.16.1 release, 2026-09-08; src has moved through the whole lane merge since). CI's plugin-bundle-freshness job diffs a rebuild against the committed file, so it is red on this branch for every src change. Left untouched deliberately per decision 01M2M22KYZ3AE0ZAYFXXG6SFTN (editing plugin/ forces a version bump and is release work under Dave's authority). Verified separately that the bundle WOULD carry the table once rebuilt: esbuild inlines calibration.json as an object literal, no runtime path.
